newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares up an noon on strong sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares up an noon on strong sentiment.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index rose strongly on Thursday morning with sentiment amongst investors boosted with the breaching of the key 78-point resistance level, brokers said.
The B index surged 2.673 points or 3.48 percent to 79.543 points on volume of 19.66 million worth $9.68 million, compared with $5.07 million on Wednesday.
Brokers said fresh overseas funds were seen flowing into the market on the back of the more than 20 percent rise in the B share index since the start of the year.
The Shanghai A share index fell on a technical correction, but downward potential is limited with market sentiment still solid, brokers said.
The index fell 8.514 points or 0.61 percent to 1,383.415 points on volume of 330.3 million shares worth 4.0 billion yuan.
The SSE30 index slipped 27.806 points or 0.77 percent to 3,565.489 points.
Newcomer Acheng Steel 600799.SS was the bigger loser on profit-taking, falling 0.78 yuan or 6.01 percent to 12.18 yuan on volume of 3.9 million shares.
